title: policy_coverage
description: A coverage, benefit or rider in force on a policy, either at policy level or for one risk.

extended_reporting_end_date.description: End of tail coverage, if purchased.

asl_code.description: Overrides the coverage definition's statutory line.

annualized_premium_amount.description: Full-term premium for this version of the coverage as rated.

effective_date.description: First business date this row applies.

expiration_date.description: Business date this row stops applying (exclusive); null while open-ended.

added_by_transaction_id.description: Policy transaction that introduced this row.

removed_by_transaction_id.description: Policy transaction that removed or superseded this row.
